description: MEDENT ASCII Field List - fields available for financial/billing data export via the Data Export Module

fields.name: Charge Balance
fields.notes: When this is used the system will take the charge amount and subtract what is in the voucher field to get charge balance.

fields.name: Hold Status
fields.notes: Pulls in the Hold Status of the charge from the activity file, Field #177. This will only pull the numerical code, no description is available.

fields.name: Void/Adj/Reject Flag
fields.notes:
Pulls in the description from the Void/Adj/Reject Flag from the charge detail screen, page 2. 
The flag on Payments and adjustments is located on the activity record but will follow suit of the charge.

fields.name: Adjustments

fields.name: Charge ID
fields.notes: This is a unique ID on every activity and history record. It is on every new activity record and stays with the record even when archived to the ledger history file.

fields.name: Charge Pointer
fields.notes: The record number of the charge associated with this transaction. There is a prefix of A or H for Activity or History - It will also be on the charge record in the file created.

fields.name: Charges
fields.notes: Will not pull in related charges from payment or adjustment records. See #511

fields.name: Claim Number
fields.notes: Will not pull in on Open Item Reports. Claim # is on payment records and not charge records.

fields.name: Classification Code
fields.notes: Class code related to the CPT/HCPCS code on the charge record (field 25)

fields.name: CPT_HCPCS Code
fields.notes: CPT/HCPCS code (from house code on CPT Setup)

fields.name: CPT_HCPCS Code Class
fields.notes: Class code related to the CPT/HCPCS code (from the CPT Setup)

fields.name: CPT_HCPCS Code CPT
fields.notes: CPT/HCPCS code (from CPT code listed in fee schedule)

fields.name: CPT_HCPCS Code Total Facility RVU
fields.notes: Pulls the value from the CPT/HCPCS file.  If the Total Facility RVU does not have a value, the output will be blank.

fields.name: Diagnosis ICD9
fields.notes: Pulls from the ICD-9 field in the Diagnosis Setup for ICD-9 (there is no ICD-10 equivalent)

fields.name: Expected approved amount
fields.notes: Pulls from the CPT/HCPCS Setup based on the procedure code and insurance on the charge or payment. There will be no expected approved amount for adjustments.

fields.name: HIPAA Place of Service
fields.notes: Pulls from the Place of service HIPAA Code column of the insurance attached to the charge record

fields.name: IncTo/Shared Split
fields.notes: Pulls directly from the Incident To field on the charge record

fields.name: Insurance Company Contact Person from Setup
Insurance Company Contact Phone from Setup
Insurance Company Copay Amount from Setup
Insurance Company Fee Category from Setup
Insurance Company Risk Adj Code from Setup
Insurance Company Type
fields.notes: Pulls from Activity Record #9 and History Record #13

fields.name: LEGPTID
fields.notes: Combination of patient record/dependent record numbers

fields.name: Payment Description (same as 267 HA Payment source)
Payment posted date (Pulls from Transaction Date)
Payment source (same as 226 HA Payment Description)
Post Reference:
fields.notes:
Can contain the following:
 PAY: A Payment on the transaction referenced in the charge pointer field.
 PAID: On the charge record when it has been zeroed out.
 ADJUST: An adjustment on the record referenced in the charge pointer field.
 OPEN: A charge record that has an open balance
 A date: A charge record that has payments/adjustments against it. This is the date of the last activity on the charge

fields.name: Receipts
fields.notes: Payment amount on the selected record

fields.name: Referring Doctor Regular Phone #
fields.notes: Pulls in regular phone number listed in the referring doctor file.

fields.name: Related Charge Value
fields.notes: The value of the charge record the payment/adjustment is attached to. This field will be blank for unapplied payments

fields.name: Related Unit Days
fields.notes: Will register units with payments and adjustments from the charge record

fields.name: To date
fields.notes: Through date when patient charge is for more than one day

fields.name: Unique ID
fields.notes: Unique # for activity/history records that is generated for the ASCII file only. Consists of the accounting date of the record (8 characters) and the activity/history record # (8 characters)

fields.name: Unit Days Charge Only
fields.notes: Payment and adjustment lines will not have units

fields.name: VHB Units
fields.notes: VHB = Value of Behavioral Health Unit. It is a field on the charge record that is entered through the ledger and not charge entry.
